intent: Verify the Heco Unix TopFix S9H-9J6 Nut Bolt and Washer variant (machine screw, 6 mm, 40 mm) exists but lacks the claimed extra length 80 mm, and answer <NO> with the checked SKU.
success_criteria: Base variant matching brand Heco, family Heco Unix TopFix S9H-9J6 Nut Bolt and Washer, fastener type machine screw, diameter 6 mm, length 40 mm is located
Absence of a length_mm=80 property on that variant is confirmed
Answer contains <NO> and the exact checked SKU plus its product record path

args.stdin:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT v.product_sku, v.record_path, v.product_name
  FROM product_variants v
  JOIN product_variant_properties ft ON ft.product_sku = v.product_sku AND ft.property_key = 'fastener_type' AND ft.property_value_text = :fastener_type
  JOIN product_variant_properties d  ON d.product_sku  = v.product_sku AND d.property_key  = 'diameter_mm'  AND d.property_value_number = :diameter_mm
  JOIN product_variant_properties l  ON l.product_sku  = v.product_sku AND l.property_key  = 'length_mm'    AND l.property_value_number = :length_mm
  WHERE v.brand = :brand AND v.product_name LIKE :family_like
)
SELECT b.product_sku, b.record_path, b.product_name,
       EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties e
              WHERE e.product_sku = b.product_sku
                AND e.property_key = 'length_mm'
                AND e.property_value_number = :extra_length_mm) AS has_extra_length
FROM base b;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.

answer_template.message: <NO>. Base product exists — checked SKU {match.product_sku} ({match.product_name}, fastener type machine screw, diameter 6 mm, length 40 mm) at {match.record_path}. No catalogue property for length 80 mm is present on this record, so the support note's extra length 80 mm claim is absent.
